]> 02/08/2026 7:13 Mostly sunny Sunday at Perisher.

Today is looking to be mostly sunny with occasional cloud and another top of 6 degrees, with winds north-westerly 40 to 60 km/h.

The snowmaking team was hard at work last night, with temperatures dipping to -4 degrees and 154 guns firing across the resort from 6:00pm to 1:00am. This has left conditions firm and fast underfoot, with a hard-packed base topped with man-made snow. We recommend sticking to the snowmaking areas for the best coverage!

36 lifts are scheduled to spin today. Please note, wind may impact lift operations, so please keep an eye on the lift report for real-time updates or download the Perisher App to stay in the loop! There will also be 49 groomed runs ready for your Sunday laps.

The buzz around the resort continues today - Chicks Who Shred are back on the mountain today and there's live music from Valley Animal Duo at Jax Bar and The Hootie Tooties at Blue Cow Bistro. The Double Discount Sale also continues for Epic Australia Pass holders, who can enjoy 30% off hardwear, outerwear and clothing at Perisher's retail outlets until Monday!

Looking ahead, a cool change is on its way to Perisher with snow in the forecast for Monday and Tuesday!
